name: Category Entry Points (CEPs) Mapping
diagnostic: Across all the discrete situations, emotional states, and environments that trigger category purchases, how many mental pathways connect to our brand?
artifact: A Cognitive Retrieval Network Map of the contextual triggers — Why, When, Where, With Whom, and With What buyers enter the market — paired with competitive ownership scores for each node.
trap: Concentrating brand messaging on a single niche entry point, which artificially caps market penetration.
artifactFull: A 7-W Cognitive Retrieval Network Map documenting the contextual triggers: Why, When, Where, With Whom, and With What buyers enter the market, paired with competitive ownership scores for each node.
trapFull: Concentrating brand messaging on a single niche entry point, which artificially caps market penetration.
sourceNote: The source calls this map 7-W and lists five Ws; the card prints the five the source lists and invents no more.
